_comment: One source of truth for colour. tailwind.config.ts and scripts/generate-icons.mjs both read this file, so a hex is never written down twice. Change it here and both the UI and the home-screen icon follow.
headline: #2a1338
_logo: Sampled from assets/logo.png: its own purple is #8b03bf, repainted to `folder` on generation so the icon and the app agree. Its cream is #fcdec3 and its wine #75092c — recorded here because they are the mark's other two colours, not because the UI uses them yet.
